senses.gloss: m. (רָפָא) curing; (sub. דמי) indemnity for curing expenses.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Avodah Zarah 2:2">Ab. Zar. II, 2</cite> <he>מתרפאין מהן ר׳ ממון אבל לא ר׳ נפשות</he> you may employ their (the gentiles’) services for curing your belonging (beasts), but not for curing your bodies.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 13:2:4">Y. Keth. XIII, 35ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>ר׳ נפש … ר׳ ממון</he> (<cite ref="Mishnah Nedarim 4:4">Ned. IV, 4</cite> <he>רפואת</he>).
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Kamma 8:1">B. Kam. VIII, 1</cite> <he>בר׳ ושבת</he> indemnity for curing and for loss of time; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 9:3:4">Y. Snh. IX, 27ᵃ</cite> bot.; a. e.
